cmd: id; echo VIRTUAL_ENV=$VIRTUAL_ENV; echo RH2_BASHENV_WRITE=$( ( : >> /rh2/bash_env ) 2>/dev/null && echo WRITABLE || echo DENIED ); python -c 'import sys; print("RH2_SYS_EXECUTABLE="+sys.executable)'; python -c 'import scrapy, scrapy.responsetypes as m; print("scrapy", scrapy.__version__, scrapy.__file__, m.__file__)'; python -m pip --version 2>&1 | head -1; python -m pytest --version 2>&1 | head -1; git status --porcelain=v1; echo PORCELAIN_RC=$?
